components.name: full_file_weights_proxy
components.basis: Entire published text GGUF; both untied vocab matrices included.

components.name: largest_f32_matrix_scratch
components.basis: 131072*5120*4 / MiB; defensive largest fallback, not observed allocation.

components.name: graph_scheduler_activations_logits

components.name: additional_retained_pool_alignment

components.name: loading_transients
components.basis: Engineering allowance beyond resident weight proxy.

limitations: Allocator/liveness/fragmentation/workspace/loading allowances are engineering estimates, not proven upper bounds.
Pinned SM80 MMQ supports expected Q4_K/Q6_K; no actual candidate kernel/load tested.
Both vocab matrices are resident, but largest one-matrix scratch plus retained-pool allowance is used; simultaneous unbounded duplicate expansion is not assumed safe.
Actual header/type/layout/context/quant policy changes require review before launch.
Future GPU admission and lifetime monitoring must use fresh free-memory margin; 28672 is not an allocation cap.
